package vparquet4

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"github.com/gogo/protobuf/proto"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/tempopb"
	"os"
	"sort"
	"testing"
)

func TestPulseValueEnvelopes(t *testing.T) {
	for _, spec := range []struct{ File, Prefix, Field string }{{"oracle.json", "result", "response"}, {"dynamic-filters.json", "filtered", "complete"}} {
		raw, err := os.ReadFile("/tmp/pulse-more-discovery/" + spec.File)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		var cases []map[string]json.RawMessage
		if err = json.Unmarshal(raw, &cases); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		for i, c := range cases {
			var values tempopb.SearchTagValuesV2Response
			if err = json.Unmarshal(c[spec.Field], &values); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			set := map[string]bool{}
			for _, v := range values.TagValues {
				set[v.Value] = true
			}
			strings := []string{}
			for v := range set {
				strings = append(strings, v)
			}
			sort.Strings(strings)
			wire, err := os.ReadFile(fmt.Sprintf("/tmp/pulse-more-discovery/v1-%s-%02d.protobuf", spec.Prefix, i))
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			got := &tempopb.SearchTagValuesResponse{}
			if err = proto.Unmarshal(wire, got); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if !proto.Equal(got, &tempopb.SearchTagValuesResponse{TagValues: strings}) {
				t.Fatalf("v1 envelope %s/%d got=%s", spec.Prefix, i, got.String())
			}
		}
	}
}
